title: Uttararchika: Liturgical Chants & Cosmic Harmony
summary: The musical fulfillment of the Vedic sacrifice, leading the soul into transcendence.
ai_summary: The second Archana structures sacrificial melodies into triads and triplets chanted by the Udgatars.

verses.original: पुनानः सोम धारयापो वसानो अर्षसि । आ रत्नधा योनिमृतस्य सीदसि ॥
verses.transliteration: punānaḥ soma dhārayāpo vasāno arṣasi | ā ratnadhā yonimṛtasya sīdasi ||
verses.translation: Being purified in a steady stream, robed in the waters, Thou flowest forth; bestower of gems, Thou sittest on the foundation of cosmic Truth (Rita).

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: Soma robed in water symbolizes spirit entering manifestation to establish cosmic harmony (Rita).

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: पवित्र धारा में प्रवाहित होते हुए सोमदेव सत्य (ऋत) के दिव्य स्थान पर विराजमान होते हैं।

verses.original: यज्ञो हि देवहितः कल्पतान्नः सोमस्य धारा पवतामदाभ्या ॥
verses.transliteration: yajño hi devahitaḥ kalpatānnaḥ somasya dhārā pavatāmadābhyā ||
verses.translation: May the sacrifice, benevolent to the gods, prosper our welfare; may the inviolable stream of Soma flow forth in purity.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: Sacrifice (Yajna) aligned with divine will brings prosperity to all beings.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: देवताओं के अनुकूल यह यज्ञ हमारा कल्याण सिद्ध करे।

verses.original: मित्रं वयं हवामहे वरुणं सोमपीतये । ता नो धत्तं सुचेतसं ॥
verses.transliteration: mitraṁ vayaṁ havāmahe varuṇaṁ somapītaye | tā no dhattaṁ sucetasam ||
verses.translation: We invoke Mitra and Varuna to drink the sacred Soma; may they endow us with an awakened and pure mind.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: Mitra (universal love) and Varuna (cosmic law) together bestow Sucetas (pure consciousness).

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: हम मित्र और वरुण का आह्वान करते हैं; वे हमें निर्मल बुद्धि प्रदान करें।

verses.original: वायवा याहि दर्शतेमे सोमा अरंकृताः । तेषां पाहि श्रुधी हवं ॥
verses.transliteration: vāyavā yāhi darśateme somā araṅkṛtāḥ | teṣāṁ pāhi śrudhī havaṁ ||
verses.translation: Come, O glorious Vayu! These Soma drops are prepared for Thee; partake of them and hear our prayer.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: Vayu is the vital breath (Prana), first recipient of divine vitality in the sacrifice.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: हे दर्शनप्रिय वायुदेव, हमारे समीप आएं और हमारी प्रार्थना सुनें।

verses.original: बृहस्पते अति यदर्यो अर्हाद् द्युमद्विभाति क्रतुमज्जनेषु । यद्दीदयच्छवस ऋतप्रजात तदस्मासु द्रविणं धेहि चित्रम् ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspate ati yadaryo arhād dyumadvibhāti kratumajjaneṣu | yaddīdayacchavasa ṛtaprajāta tadasmāsu draviṇaṁ dhehi citram ||
verses.translation: O Brihaspati, that splendid treasure which shineth bright among men, rich in spiritual wisdom, born of divine Truth — bestow that marvelous treasure upon us!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: Brihaspati, master of prayer and intellect, bestows the true treasure of enlightened wisdom (Rita-prajata).

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: हे बृहस्पति, सत्य से उत्पन्न वह तेजस्वी ज्ञान-धन हमें प्रदान करें।

verses.original: प्र देवाय धर्पणे मन्द्रेण वचसा गिरः । भरध्वं हव्यं मानुषे ॥
verses.transliteration: pra devāya dharṣaṇe mandreṇa vacasā giraḥ | bharadhvaṁ havyaṁ mānuṣe ||
verses.translation: With joyous words and hymns, bring forth your songs and offerings to the courageous divine guardian who dwells among mortals.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: Chanting in deep resonant melody (Mandra Vacha) invokes the divine indweller.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: गंभीर वाणी से ईश्वर की महिमा गाते हुए अपने भाव समर्पित करो।

verses.original: अभि त्यं देवं सवितारमोण्योः कविक्रतुमर्चामि सत्यसंवम् ।
verses.transliteration: abhi tyaṁ devaṁ savitāramoṇyoḥ kavikratumarcāmi satyasaṁvam |
verses.translation: I worship that radiant Savita, possessor of poetic wisdom, true in impulse, who awakens both heaven and earth with His light.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: Savita is the divine inspirer of spiritual vision (Kavikratu), the inner sun of awareness.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: हम सत्यप्रेरक और क्रांतदर्शी सविता देव की वंदना करते हैं।

verses.original: द्यावापृथिवी विश्वशम्भुवौ स्तुषे यज्ञेषु धिषणा मही ।
verses.transliteration: dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśambhuvau stuṣe yajñeṣu dhiṣaṇā mahī |
verses.translation: Heaven and Earth, sources of all universal blessings, I praise in the sacrifices, along with the great goddess of contemplative wisdom.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: Heaven and Earth as cosmic parents who sustain and protect all life.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: द्युलोक और पृथ्वी समस्त सुखों के स्रोत हैं, जिनकी स्तुति हम करते हैं।

verses.original: विष्णोर्नु कं वीर्याणि प्र वोचं यः पार्थिवानि विममे रजांसि । यो अस्कभायदुत्तरं सधस्थं विचक्रमाणास्त्रेधोरुगायः ॥
verses.transliteration: viṣṇornu kaṁ vīryāṇi pra vocaṁ yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāṁsi | yo askabhāyaduttaraṁ sadhasthaṁ vicakramāṇastredhorugāyaḥ ||
verses.translation: I will now proclaim the heroic deeds of Vishnu, who measured out the earthly regions, who established the high celestial abode, striding thrice, the widely-extolled!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The famous Vedic celebration of Vishnu measuring the physical, subtle, and causal realms in three strides.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: मैं श्रीविष्णु के पराक्रम का गान करता हूँ जिन्होंने तीनों लोकों को तीन पगों में नाप लिया।

verses.original: तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः । दिवीव चक्षुराततम् ॥
verses.transliteration: tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṁ padaṁ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ | divīva cakṣurātatam ||
verses.translation: That supreme state of Vishnu the enlightened seers behold perpetually, like an eye outspread across the heavens.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: Vishnu's supreme abode (Parama Pada) is unclouded non-dual consciousness, ever perceived by awakened seers.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: विष्णु का वह परम पद ज्ञानी जनों द्वारा आकाश में फैले नेत्र के समान सदा प्रत्यक्ष देखा जाता है।
